decisive_items: Complete loss of photoreceptors, ellipsoid zone, and retinal pigment epithelium in superotemporal region
Fundus examination: Few yellow spots present, no pigmentary degeneration
response.rationale: Choroideremia classically presents with night blindness, peripheral field loss, absent bone-spicule pigmentation, and OCT showing RPE/photoreceptor loss with central macular preservation; the superotemporal RPE loss and yellow spots fit. Retinitis pigmentosa is less likely due to lack of pigmentary degeneration despite ERG and field findings.

rejected.why: No pigmentary degeneration on fundus, which is atypical for retinitis pigmentosa; OCT shows RPE loss more consistent with choroideremia.
